# Annetta Bell

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P25](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Annetta Bell is a pale, petite individual. She has fine, silky, fawn-colored hair that flows over her shoulders in smooth ripples.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Annetta Bell is prone to sudden outbursts of hysterics. Her reactions are easily triggered by unsettling situations, such as not knowing the whereabouts of a mouse.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P25](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0025)_

## Traits

- prone to hysterics  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P25](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0025)</sub>

## History

Annetta Bell moved to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school district after her parents relocated their house fifty yards north of its original site. As a student in [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's classroom, she submitted a school assignment in which she copied an old love letter. [Anne](../character/anne.md) later shared this humorous anecdote about Annetta in a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), +84 more_
